response.sql: SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId)

assumptions.assumption: Only rows with grid >= 12 are used, so grid 0 (pit-lane start) is excluded. Drivers are grouped by driverId, and each driver's points are summed and laps averaged over their qualifying rows. NULL laps are ignored by AVG, and laps is cast from TEXT to a number. Drivers with no qualifying rows are not counted.
